research: A possible lead is the 1625 enfeoffment of Bishop Philipp Adolf von Ehrenberg with a quarter of Aub previously purchased from the Rosenberg brothers and confiscated as a fief. See Germania Sacra, third series, vol. 4, Die Würzburger Bischöfe von 1617 bis 1684, p. 159 n. 214, citing StAWü, Lehensachen 4529, fol. 490 and LDF 41, pp. 240–244 (6 June 1625). The undated Wertheim catalogue entry names no fiefs, so it is unclear whether this was the same dispute.
